_about: Dynasty I Ching (event) cards. 'copies' sums to 20. Province 8 is the Warlord.

cards.title: Drought
cards.flavor: Not a cloud in months. The locusts, at least, are having a fine year.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.

cards.title: Steady Weather
cards.flavor: Neither feast nor famine. Nobody writes poems about years like this.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.

cards.title: Bad Harvest
cards.flavor: The seed rotted, the rains came late, and the ox went lame.
effects: All provinces collect a bad harvest.

cards.title: Spring Floods
cards.flavor: Heaven waters the land generously. In some places, far too generously.
effects: Provinces 1, 3, 6, 7: good harvest.
Provinces 2, 4, 5, 8: bad harvest.

cards.title: Heaven Has Favourites
cards.flavor: Some fields shine, some fields sulk.
effects: Provinces 2, 4, 5: good harvest.
Provinces 1, 3, 6, 7, 8: bad harvest.

cards.title: Population Doubles
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
The population doubles, and every province's consumption doubles with it.
If the population is already 600 million, or the population has already doubled twice, ignore this card except for the good harvest.

cards.title: Population Grows by Half
cards.flavor: The villages are noisier than they used to be.
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
The population increases by one half, and so does every province's consumption.
If the population is already 600 million, or it has already grown by half once, ignore this card except for the good harvest.

cards.title: Careless Prosperity
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
Every player plays a Personal Disaster.

cards.title: Fortune and Misfortune
cards.flavor: Plenty for everyone, and trouble for some.
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
Provinces 2, 4, 6, 8 play a Personal Disaster.

cards.title: Storms and Raiders
cards.flavor: A fine crop, and a fine season for gales, bandits and the Warlord's sense of humour.
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
Provinces 4, 5, 6, 7 each pay 2 million to repair their Public Works.
Provinces 1, 2, 3, 8 play a Personal Disaster.

cards.title: The Canal Gives Way
cards.flavor: The engineers blame the river. The river declines to comment.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.

All unfinished Grand Canal work is lost. In a province where both canal sections are finished, that province pays the Emperor 2 million. Where only one section stands, the Emperor must build it again.
Provinces 2, 3, 7, 8 play a Personal Disaster.

cards.title: The Wall Is Breached
cards.flavor: The harvest is in, and so are the horsemen from the north.
effects: All provinces collect a good harvest.
Three Great Wall links are breached. Provinces 1, 2, 3 each pay 5 million for repairs; a province with no wall built above it pays 2 million in damages to the Harvest Pile instead.
Provinces 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 play a Personal Disaster.

cards.title: Imperial Charity
cards.flavor: Moved by the suffering of their people, the Emperor opens their purse. Slightly.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.
Every player receives 2 million from the Emperor's reserve.

cards.title: The Emperor's Share
cards.flavor: The Emperor would like to remind you who paid for the ditch.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.
Every province with a Public Works splits the extra harvest it produces 50/50 with the Emperor this round.

cards.title: Utility Tax
cards.flavor: A new levy, for the upkeep of things you may or may not have.
effects: All provinces collect an average harvest.
Every province pays the Emperor a 2 million utility tax.
Every province with a Public Works pays 2 million more.
